image_description: A close-up, angled view of a vintage-style aneroid barometer. The instrument features a circular brass casing with a glass cover. Inside, there is a white dial face with black markings and a central ornate pointer mechanism. A wooden lever or handle extends from the bottom right. The background is plain white.

The wooden extension at the bottom right has a smooth, plastic-like texture lacking realistic wood grain, and its connection to the brass body is slightly ambiguous.
The elliptical perspective of the rim is slightly inconsistent with the angle of the face, suggesting minor geometric warping.
